claim_policy.intended_use: matched five-world parallel agent-system characterization under the existing G2 material-information intervention
claim_policy.estimand: descriptive agent-system-by-world profiles under fixed world, information, action, resource, observation, and scoring contracts
claim_policy.comparison_unit: complete agent system, including backend and direct-operation scaffold
not_intended_to_test: a provider-backend causal effect isolated from scaffold
population-level significance from five development worlds

execution_order.rationale: run each matched pair serially while executing five independent world pairs concurrently

semantics.attempts: every submitted primitive action, including invalid and resource-rejected proposals
semantics.allocation: one campaign-wide pool; no per-vessel equal split and no hidden future-vessel reservation
semantics.stock_envelope: two public maximum single-addition envelopes per planned vessel, shared globally to preserve semibatch freedom
semantics.operation_ceiling: 24 attempts per planned vessel in aggregate; a loop-safety and interaction-cost ceiling intended not to be the primary binding physical resource

analysis.scope: five-world parallel agent-system demonstration under the published G2 physical and information contracts
primary_descriptive_endpoints: provider calls, tokens, wall time, and billed cost
analysis.cross_agent_policy: compare full behavioral profiles at matched worlds and arms; do not attribute differences to backend alone
analysis.small_n_policy: report all ten trajectories and paired world values descriptively; do not use population-level significance language
